parent_objective: audit why rejected-branch retention restored M267 preflight at some alphas but lost exact low-tail candidate overlap
blocked_by: M949 has M267 preflight pass alphas but zero exact candidate alphas
invalidates: full replay, PPO, or promotion from M949 raw update

public_gates: M950 must classify the 0.075-0.100 objective conflict boundary
M950 must choose between coefficient retuning, trajectory-target export, or branch synthesis
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune after looking at private holdout
do not run full replay from a non-candidate
do not open encoders or GRU without synthesis

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_replay: rejected-branch retention versus exact low-tail objective conflict
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: classifies whether M949 needs coefficient retuning, richer rejected trajectory targets, or branch synthesis
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no training, no full replay, no promotion
stop_condition: stop if M949 conflict is explained by the 0.075-0.100 alpha boundary
stop if objective retuning would be another narrow local tweak without synthesis
stop if trajectory-target export is required before another probe
fallback_plan: if coefficient retuning is justified, route to one bounded design milestone
if action proxies are insufficient, route to rejected-branch trajectory target export
if the branch is over-optimized, route to synthesis

hypothesis: M949 exposed a real tradeoff: low alphas preserve M267 proof but lack tail lift, while higher alphas lift low-tail metrics but break normal retention or M267 proof.
success_criteria: next route is selected without training, full replay, PPO, or promotion
failure_criteria: audit recommends full replay from a non-candidate
audit ignores the M267 preflight and exact candidate mismatch

commands.name: write_audit
commands.command: Inspect M949 alpha metrics and preflight rows, write the objective-conflict audit, then route the next milestone.

decision_rule: M950 may only audit the M949 conflict and choose the next route. It must not train, full-replay a non-candidate, PPO, or promote.
